added.summary: A document plays an og.VideoPlayer (its frame as the element's picture) or og.AudioSource entity from a store, with Svelte's bind:paused, bind:currentTime, bind:duration, bind:volume, bind:muted, bind:ended and autoplay, loop, poster and controls. A literal src is refused: spawn the player in a system and bind its entity.
The recorded intent a document's <video> or <audio> sends its player (play, pause, seek, gain, loop), applied by og.video at the next tick. Registered lazily, once a document with one loads.
